source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the types of UML diagrams (PDF 20).

blocks.text: Yeh hissa UML ke chaar qism ke diagrams par baat karta hai, har ek nizam ka alag pehlu dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: Is chapter ke chaar UML diagrams
rows: actors aur woh maqasid (use cases) jo woh nizam se hasil karte hain
classes, un ke attributes aur methods, aur aapas ke rishte
objects ke darmiyan waqt ki tarteeb mein bheje gaye paigham
kisi amal mein qadmon aur faislon ka bahao

blocks.prompt: Objects ke darmiyan paighamat ki tarteeb dikhane ke liye kaunsa UML diagram banayenge?
blocks.explanation: Sequence diagram, jo objects ko saath saath aur un ke darmiyan paighamat ko oopar se neeche waqt ki tarteeb mein rakhta hai.

items: Yahan chaar UML diagrams: use case (actors aur maqasid), class (banawat), sequence (waqt ki tarteeb mein paigham), activity (qadmon ka bahao).
